display_name: 源域双受损视图的频谱比值匹配诊断
description: 对 672 条合法源记录的三个受损视图，比较频谱与相邻频谱比值的跨视图同记录检索；不读取源 clean IQ 数值或目标。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 CPU, one BLAS thread, nice 19; no GPU or training

data.representation: Three aligned source received IQ [2,256]; no clean IQ values used
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Fixed 672 previously explored source pilot IDs; no TX labels, not independent generalization evidence
data.leo_config_ref: Three fixed source augmentation epochs, scored separately by query scene

permissions.claim_scope: Source crossview same-record retrieval diagnostic only; not transmitter identity or target performance

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: source_inputs validates fixed source L_s/U_s pilot; source cache physical IDs resolve to same original array
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No learned checkpoint or F weights or outputs
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 0.01 regularization and all three view pairs before result

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, one BLAS thread, nice 19; preserve other processes
execution.launch_command: nice -n 19 env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u -m experiments.phase1_dura_orthogonal.spectral_crossview_probe --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261108-phase1-spectral-crossview-source-diagnostic-s2026092701-r01 --commit a3f68690c45a56f7251f688f4bf24002f20e8317
execution.stop_rule: Stop own process on source contract mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite data, output collision, or unauthorized data access; preserve artifacts.

expected_artifacts: result.json with 6 groups, both-damaged and query-scene summaries

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: source record correspondence only; no target truth or TX label

rows.method: Normalized complex FFT versus regularized adjacent complex FFT ratio; same 336-candidate set per receiver group
rows.purpose: Source-only robustness across two impaired views, no target performance claim
rows.seed_notes: Existing fixed source IDs and precomputed source augmentations; no model or new randomness.
rows.scenario: three fixed source view pairs with both-damaged subset
rows.budget_ref: 672 source IQ IDs x 3 cached epochs; 336 candidates per receiver group; eight-record source smoke
rows.command: nice -n 19 env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /home/szu2070436088/.conda/envs/CVS-RFFI/bin/python -X utf8 -u -m experiments.phase1_dura_orthogonal.spectral_crossview_probe --root /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet --out /home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/runs/20261108-phase1-spectral-crossview-source-diagnostic-s2026092701-r01 --commit a3f68690c45a56f7251f688f4bf24002f20e8317

notes: Prerecorded exploratory criterion: quotient both-damaged top-1 exceeds spectrum by at least 5 percentage points in at least 5 of 6 receiver/view-pair groups; source diagnostic only.
Clean IQ values, TX labels, F weights/output, V and any target data are not read; scene metadata is used only to report the both-damaged subset.
No learned checkpoint is used, so checkpoint smoke is not applicable; real source eight-record no-query smoke runs first.
Same-record correspondence is an evaluation oracle, not device identity, deployment evidence or an identity accuracy metric.
